column4: Comprises incinerable waste that are sent to the incineration plants and non-incinerable waste that are sent directly to Semakau Landfill.  Data from 2015 exclude metals recovered from incineration bottom ash in a metal recovery facility that is commissioned in 2015.
Refers to waste collected from households and trade premises (e.g., shophouses, educational institutions, petrol stations, hawker centres and places of worship).
Refers to waste generated at industrial and commercial premises.
Refers to waste recovered and processed at local recycling facilities or exported overseas for recycling.
